# FolioSpace

> One-page portfolio for every Indian professional — chefs, developers, students, consultants, shop owners, agencies, founders. ₹149/month via UPI AutoPay.

## About

FolioSpace turns a single URL into a public folio. Sign up with email or OAuth (GitHub, Google, LinkedIn). Pick a slug, fill in your work, ship a portfolio. Free forever, Pro unlocks custom domain + analytics + remove branding.

- Pricing: ₹0 free, ₹149/month Pro (₹1,499/year)
- Trial: 15-day Pro on signup, no card required
- Cancel anytime via UPI AutoPay

## Key pages

- [Home](https://foliospace.in/): product overview, social proof, pricing summary
- [Pricing](https://foliospace.in/pricing): full plan comparison, FAQ
- [Features](https://foliospace.in/features): what's shipped today, what's next on the roadmap (GitHub import, LinkedIn import, custom domain)
- [Community](https://foliospace.in/space-community): waitlist + charter for the community tier
- [Privacy](https://foliospace.in/privacy): data retention, GDPR/India DPDP
- [Terms](https://foliospace.in/terms): UPI AutoPay cancellation terms

## Public folios

Every user gets `/<slug>`. Examples live at:
- https://foliospace.in/allarohithnaidu (founder)

## API surface

Public:
- `GET /sitemap.xml`: sitemap of every public folio + static pages
- `GET /<slug>`: public folio (404 if `is_public=false`)
- `GET /<slug>/og.png`: dynamic Open Graph image (1200×630)
- `GET /<slug>/qr.png`: QR code for share
- `GET /robots.txt`: blocks `/admin/`, `/dashboard/`, `/api/`

Authenticated:
- `POST /signup`, `POST /login`, `POST /forgot`, `POST /reset`
- `GET/POST /<slug>/manage`: edit folio
- `GET /dashboard`: visits analytics (30-day sparkline)
